profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on React Native supporting desktop platforms.

positions.title: Principal SDE Lead
positions.description:
- Engineering lead in Commercial Software Engineering (CSE), helping Microsoft customers solve problems related to Azure and other Microsoft products.
- Leading remote team of 8 engineers working directly with customers looking to leverage the latest technologies to address their toughest challenges & transform their industries using cloud-based solutions. 
- Primary focus is Conversational AI and DevOps.

positions.title: Senior SDE Lead
positions.description:
- Engineering lead in CSE, helping Microsoft customers solve problems related to Azure and other Microsoft products.
- Led two different remote teams of 4 engineers working on tech evangelism and customer engineering projects.
- Maintainer of react-native-windows open source project, growing the project to become one of the top open source projects in Microsoft, with nearly 6,000 stars on GitHub.
- Collaborated with the Skype team on performance improvements to the react-native-windows project in preparation for their UWP app release targeting Windows 10 RS5.
- Worked on engineering projects with customers related to iOS, Android, Azure Event Hubs, Azure Search, differential privacy, and blockchain.
- Tech evangelism activities including speaking at developer conferences, social media activity and contributions to developer blogs.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineer in Developer Experience (DX), helping strategic Microsoft customers solve problems related to Azure and other Microsoft products.
- Started the react-native-windows open source project on GitHub, allowing React Native developers to re-use their existing codebase for iOS and Android to target UWP and WPF platforms.
- Collaborated with Facebook and React Native maintainers to enable third-party platform implementations (such as react-native-windows) to plug in to the react-native ecosystem (native modules, CLI, common libraries, etc.).
- Collaborated with Microsoft customers on projects related to UWP, Xamarin, Azure Container Service (Mesos), and blockchain. 
- Tech evangelism on behalf of Microsoft including speaking engagements at developer conferences, social media activity, and contributions to developer blogs.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer 2
positions.description:
- Engineer in Bing working on Reactor, a distributed, fault tolerant stream processing engine based on Rx.NET used to enable the proactive experiences in Cortana.
- Developed LINQ expression serialization stack to enable local composition of LINQ operations applied to event streams in the cloud.
- Lead developer on fault tolerance test harness that used Rx.NET virtual time scheduling concepts to inject failures between all events in the query pipeline to identify bugs in the checkpoint / recovery mechanism.
- Optimized memory footprint of core query execution engine to increase query density on each compute node and reduce garbage collection load.
- Co-inventor on 6 patents related to our work on Reactor.

positions.title: Student Fellow
positions.description: Student Fellow for the ESIP Discovery Cluster.  Rapporteur, collaborative technology support, and collaboration within cluster.  Awarded a mini-grant to publish linked data for the Earth and Space Science Informatics sections at the annual American Geophysical Union meetings.

company.name: Federation of Earth Science Informatics Partners

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description: Contributed to the Resource Discovery for Extreme Scale Collaboration project, a collaboration between the Tetherless World Constellation at RPI and Pacific Northwest National Laboratories.  Project work included ontology design, Web crawling for datasets using the Scrapy framework, and metadata normalization.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Contributed to the NSF-sponsored Semantic eScience Framework project at the Tetherless World Constellation.  My work included: design and development of a faceted browsing platform, design of a Semantic Web service ontology for web application integration and reuse, ontology modularization, temporal reasoning, data discovery, and RDB to RDF mappings.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Intern in the Online Services Division (Bing) working on entity disambiguation techniques and Web services for structured entity data. I collaborated with engineering teams in Office to build out services for the initial proof-of-concept of the Smart Lookup for Office feature.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Intern in the Microsoft Research Connections group.  Applied topic extraction techniques, including a Web-scale probabilistic knowledge base (Mircosoft's Probase), Latent Dirichlet Allocation, and Explicit Semantic Analysis, to improve content-based recommendation systems from unstructured text.

positions.title: Summer Student Fellow
positions.description: Collaborated with scientists, information technologists, and data managers from multiple oceanographic disciplines, documenting use cases for a research cruise preparation application.  Designed and developed a data dashboard for accessing heterogeneous, multidisciplinary oceanographic datasets using JavaScript, PHP, and the OpenSearch specification.

positions.title: Darrin Foundation Summer Undergraduate Research Fellow
positions.description: Worked on knowledge modeling, evaluating temporal metadata models for the NSF-sponsored Virtual Solar Terrestrial Observatory.

projects.title: NLU.DevOps
projects.description: CLI tool for composing CI/CD pipelines to iterate on NLU model performance.

projects.title: React Native Windows
projects.description: This project adds a platform extension to React Native to support Universal Windows Platform applications for Desktop, Mobile, Xbox, HoloLens, IoT, etc.

patents.title: Enrichment of named entities in documents via contextual attribute ranking
patents.description: Technologies pertaining to retrieval of contextually relevant attribute values for an automatically identified named entity in a document are described herein. Named entity recognition technologies are employed to identify named entities in the text of a document. Context corresponding to an identified named entity is analyzed to probabilistically assign a class to the named entity. Attributes that are most relevant to the class are determined, and attribute values for such attributes are retrieved. The attribute values are presented in correlation with the named entity in the document responsive to user-selection of the named entity in the document.
